name: go2rtc-cameras
title: Go2rtc Cameras
description: Keep every go2rtc camera searchable from Raycast Root Search and open it in your preferred player.
author: rainnworks

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: go2rtc Address
preferences.description: The address of your go2rtc WebUI. A root address, subpath, or pasted stream page link all work.

preferences.name: username
preferences.title: Username
preferences.description: Optional HTTP Basic Auth username for the go2rtc WebUI.

preferences.name: password
preferences.title: Password
preferences.description: Optional HTTP Basic Auth password. Raycast stores password preferences securely.

preferences.name: defaultAction
preferences.title: Default Action
preferences.description: Choose what pressing Return on a camera does.

preferences.name: preferredApplication
preferences.title: Preferred App
preferences.description: Optional media player for streams, such as IINA, VLC, or mpv. The browser remains the fallback.

preferences.name: playbackFormat
preferences.title: Player Stream Format
preferences.description: HTTP MP4 works through most reverse proxies. RTSP usually has the lowest latency but needs port 8554 to be reachable.

preferences.name: rtspBaseUrl
preferences.title: RTSP Address
preferences.description: Optional. Used only for RTSP; defaults to the go2rtc hostname on port 8554.

preferences.name: passCredentialsToPlayer
preferences.title: Pass Login to Player
preferences.description: Embed the WebUI login in HTTP player URLs. Enable only if your player needs it; media apps may retain opened URLs in history or logs.
preferences.label: Include the go2rtc username and password when opening a preferred app

preferences.name: includeSubstreamsInRootSearch
preferences.title: Include Substreams
preferences.description: Add separate Root Search shortcuts for _sub streams when the matching main stream also exists.
preferences.label: Show main and substream shortcuts in Root Search

commands.name: sync-camera-shortcuts
commands.title: Sync Camera Shortcuts
commands.subtitle: go2rtc
commands.description: Add, update, and remove managed Root Search commands to match go2rtc.

commands.name: browse-cameras
commands.title: Browse Cameras
commands.subtitle: go2rtc
commands.description: Search and open cameras from your go2rtc server.

commands.name: setup-root-search
commands.title: Set Up Cameras in Root Search
commands.subtitle: go2rtc
commands.description: Finish or repair the one-time Raycast Script Commands folder setup.

commands.name: open-camera
commands.title: Open Camera
commands.subtitle: go2rtc
commands.description: Open a named go2rtc camera. Used by the managed camera shortcuts.

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo "Use npm run publish to publish this Raycast extension." && exit 1
